note: Groups of existing services and programs by life event, for the home page doors and /buhay/ pages. Every id must exist in services.json or programs.json; the facts and sources stay on those records.

events.line_fil: Irehistro ang kapanganakan, ipa-check-up ang sanggol at ipabakuna.
events.line_en: Register the birth, get the baby checked and vaccinated.

events.line_fil: Scholarship, Pamantasan ng Lungsod ng Pasig at tulong sa pamasahe.
events.line_en: Scholarships, the city university and help with fares.

events.line_fil: Job referral sa PESO, internship sa lungsod at trabaho para sa estudyante.
events.line_en: PESO job referrals, city internships and work for students.

events.line_fil: Business name, business permit, puwesto sa palengke at puhunan.
events.line_en: Business name, business permit, a market stall and a loan.

events.line_fil: Marriage license, counseling, civil wedding at pagrehistro ng kasal.
events.line_en: Marriage license, counseling, a civil wedding and registering it.

events.line_fil: Amilyar, tax declaration, building permit at pabahay ng lungsod.
events.line_en: Property tax, tax declarations, building permits and city housing.

events.line_fil: Senior ID, pensyon ng lungsod, libreng gamot at cash gift.
events.line_en: Senior ID, the city pension, free medicine and cash gifts.

events.line_fil: PWD ID, wheelchair o saklay, cash gift at tulong sa negosyo.
events.line_en: PWD ID, a wheelchair or crutches, cash gifts and business help.

events.line_fil: Solo Parent ID, buwanang ayuda, day care at counseling.
events.line_en: Solo Parent ID, a monthly subsidy, day care and counseling.

events.line_fil: Konsulta sa ospital ng lungsod, tulong sa gastos at libreng gamot.
events.line_en: City hospital visits, help with bills and free medicine.

events.line_fil: Emergency hotline, relief goods at certificate para sa naapektuhan.
events.line_en: The emergency hotline, relief goods and a certificate for those hit.

events.line_fil: Death certificate, libreng kabaong, puwesto sa sementeryo at tulong.
events.line_en: Death registration, a free coffin, a cemetery plot and assistance.
